name: Choose examinations that distinguish active hypotheses
trigger: When the current evidence leaves competing diagnostic hypotheses unresolved.
action: State the unresolved question and what each possible report could clarify before requesting an available examination.
decision_rule: Prefer a check that can distinguish the active alternatives; do not interpret an unavailable report as a negative result.
effect: Connects each examination request to a specific diagnostic information gap.
pitfall: Ordering tests solely to confirm an initial impression, or inventing unavailable findings.
example_status: Adapted illustration; not a measured experimental output
